session_scope_chk.name: session_scope_chk
session_scope_chk.value:
("session"."session_class" IN ('external_collaborator','funeral_home') AND "session"."scope" ? 'patientId')
        OR ("session"."session_class" = 'auditor' AND "session"."engagement_start" IS NOT NULL AND "session"."engagement_end" IS NOT NULL)
        OR ("session"."session_class" = 'staff')

session_step_up_paired_write.name: session_step_up_paired_write
session_step_up_paired_write.value:
("session"."last_step_up_at" IS NULL AND "session"."last_step_up_factor" IS NULL)
        OR ("session"."last_step_up_at" IS NOT NULL AND "session"."last_step_up_factor" IS NOT NULL)

channel_unique_subject.name: channel_unique_subject
channel_unique_subject.where: subject_id IS NOT NULL AND channel_kind IN ('care_team','on_call','bereavement','location','discipline')

channel_kind_subject_shape.name: channel_kind_subject_shape
channel_kind_subject_shape.value:
CASE channel_kind
        WHEN 'care_team'    THEN subject_id IS NOT NULL AND retention_class = 'care_related'
        WHEN 'bereavement'  THEN subject_id IS NOT NULL AND retention_class = 'bereavement' AND archives_at IS NOT NULL
        WHEN 'dm'           THEN subject_id IS NULL     AND retention_class = 'care_related'
        WHEN 'announcement' THEN subject_id IS NULL     AND retention_class = 'operational'
        ELSE                     subject_id IS NOT NULL AND retention_class = 'care_related'
      END

message_status_shape.name: message_status_shape
message_status_shape.value:
(status = 'edited') = (edited_at IS NOT NULL)
      AND (status = 'deleted') = (deleted_at IS NOT NULL)

user_notif_pref_vacation_shape.name: user_notif_pref_vacation_shape
user_notif_pref_vacation_shape.value: (vacation_forward_to_user_id IS NOT NULL) = (vacation_until IS NOT NULL AND vacation_until > NOW())
